functions: followLine (b4), called from the forever loop (b3)
control_flow: followLine: if the left light is below 50 %, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start through its curves to the green goal at its end, without leaving it.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 50 % (dim light)

branches.outcome: bright light: the else part runs and it curves right

equivalence_classes: dim light under a tunnel's roof

scenarios.coded_response: It curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %) all the time; no block reads the line tracker
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line with curves, in bright light, and a green goal area lies at the line's end
scenarios.trigger: The program starts and the light stays bright
scenarios.title: Follows the line to the green goal
assumptions: The green goal covers the line's end.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line through its curves and reaches the green goal at its end without leaving the line

scenarios.title: Drives in dim light

uncertainties: You said to follow the black line, but your program reads only the light sensor and never the line tracker: it has no decision about the line.
On a plain bright floor it curves right all the time, so it circles instead of driving along a line.
Dim light exists only under a tunnel's roof, and you didn't say what the robot should do in a tunnel.
